title: Isaac
summary: Son of Abraham and Sarah, born when Abraham was 100 (Gen 21:5); father of Esau and Jacob; died aged 180 (Gen 35:28-29).

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (Floyd Nolen Jones): 1896 BC (no higher-tier year available).

birth.note: pending CFAH reference. CFAH-6 Argument 4 §5 "Isaac's Famine: ~1816 BC" says Isaac was "born in 1896 BC" (Ussher-Jones), but this is not a numbered anchor point or a CFAH-1 Table 1 row.

birth.citation: Jones, Chronology of the Old Testament (15th ed., 2002), p. 59 ("1896 BC = 2108 AM Year Isaac is born (Gen.21:5, see Chart 3)")
Gen 21:5 (Abraham 100 at Isaac's birth), taking Abraham's birth as AM 2008 (see abraham-birth)
Ussher, Annals of the World, Third Age §85 (paragraph numbering of the modern transcription)

birth.date: 2108 - In the spring Sarah gives birth to Isaac in Philistine territory (Gen. 21:1-7).
birth.citation: Jordan, "The Chronology of the Pentateuch (Part 4)," Biblical Chronology 6:6 (June 1994), §11 "The Life of Abraham" (year list)
Anno Mundi Chronology Studies (unnamed compiler; a compilation of James B. Jordan's system), p. 3, chart "Genesis 12 – 25 Chronology of Abraham’s Life"
birth.note: Agrees with Jordan's own published AM 2108.

birth.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Book II, ch. I, §IIII
birth.note: One year more than Ussher. The 1617 text puts Abraham's birth at AM 2008 (Book II, ch. I, §VIII), so 2109 does not follow from "Abraham 100" (Gen 21:5). Raleigh's Jacob (2169), Moses (2434) and flight to Midian (2474) are also one year above Ussher.

death.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 6: The Old and Middle Kingdoms of Egypt," ARJ 18 (2025): 13–60, Argument 4 §7 "Joseph was Promoted in the Year of Isaac's Death 1716/1715 BC" (new Anchor Point #61)
death.note: Component of AP-61: CFAH-6 takes Isaac's death in 1716 BC from Jones (2019, 58) and makes Joseph's promotion the same year.
